use default
use Raster.IMAGE

@equality()
class SANDPILE is
    size: int
    cells: LIST[int]

    init(size: int, cells: Iterable[int]) is
        self.size = size
        self.cells = cells |> collect_list()
        topple()
    si

    init(rows: int[][]) is
        init(rows.count, rows |> flat_map(row => row))
    si

    filled(size: int, grains: int) -> SANDPILE static =>
        SANDPILE(size, repeat(grains, size * size))

    drop(i: int) is
        cells[i] = cells[i] + 1
    si

    topple() is
        let unstable mut = true

        while unstable do
            unstable = false

            for i in 0..size * size do
                if cells[i] >= 4 then
                    unstable = true
                    cells[i] = cells[i] - 4

                    let row = i / size, column = i % size

                    if row > 0 then drop(i - size) fi
                    if row < size - 1 then drop(i + size) fi
                    if column > 0 then drop(i - 1) fi
                    if column < size - 1 then drop(i + 1) fi
                fi
            od
        od
    si

    rows: List[string] =>
        (0..size)
            |> map(r => cells |> skip(r * size) |> take(size) |> join(" "))
            |> collect_list()
si

+(a: SANDPILE, b: SANDPILE) -> SANDPILE =>
    SANDPILE(a.size, a.cells |> zip(b.cells) |> map(p => p.`0 + p.`1))

side_by_side(label: string, piles: List[SANDPILE], signs: string[]) is
    write_line(label)

    for r in 0..piles[0].size do
        let centre = r == piles[0].size / 2
        let line mut = piles[0].rows[r]

        for (i, pile) in piles |> skip(1) |> index() do
            let sign = if centre then signs[i] else " " fi

            line = "{line}  {sign}  {pile.rows[r]}"
        od

        write_line("    {line}")
    od

    write_line("")
si

let avalanche = SANDPILE([[4, 3, 3], [3, 1, 2], [0, 2, 3]])

let s1 = SANDPILE([[1, 2, 0], [2, 1, 1], [0, 1, 3]])
let s2 = SANDPILE([[2, 1, 3], [1, 0, 1], [0, 1, 0]])
let s3 = SANDPILE.filled(3, 3)
let s3_id = SANDPILE([[2, 1, 2], [1, 0, 1], [2, 1, 2]])

write_line("4 3 3 / 3 1 2 / 0 2 3 topples to")
write_line(avalanche.rows |> join(" / "))
write_line("")

side_by_side("s1 + s2 = s2 + s1:", [s1, s2, s1 + s2], ["+", "="])
write_line("s1 + s2 =~ s2 + s1: {s1 + s2 =~ s2 + s1}")
write_line("")
side_by_side("s3 + s3_id:", [s3, s3_id, s3 + s3_id], ["+", "="])
write_line("s3 + s3_id =~ s3: {s3 + s3_id =~ s3}")
write_line("")
side_by_side("s3_id + s3_id:", [s3_id, s3_id, s3_id + s3_id], ["+", "="])
write_line("s3_id + s3_id =~ s3_id: {s3_id + s3_id =~ s3_id}")

let six = SANDPILE.filled(64, 6)
let identity = SANDPILE(64, six.cells |> map(grains => 6 - grains))

write_line("")
write_line("the identity of the 64 x 64 sandpile is drawn below")

let shades = [
    (20ub, 20ub, 60ub), (40ub, 120ub, 200ub),
    (240ub, 200ub, 60ub), (200ub, 50ub, 40ub)
]
let scale = 5
let image = IMAGE(64 * scale, 64 * scale)

for (i, grains) in identity.cells |> index() do
    let (r, g, b) = shades[grains]
    let x = cast double(i % 64 * scale), y = cast double(i / 64 * scale)

    image.colour(r, g, b)
    let side = cast double(scale)

    image.fill_rectangle(x, y, x + side, y + side)
od

image.write("identity.png")

image.show("identity.png")
